result.description: Zenith Vinyl Pty Ltd  Zenith Vinyl Pty Ltd is seeking a skilled Metal Machinist (First Class) / CNC Machine Operator/Programmer to operate CNC machinery and manufacture precision components. The role involves machine setup, machining operations, reading technical drawings, performing quality checks, and ensuring products meet required specifications and standards.   Benefits   Competitive salary based on skills and experience.  Opportunity to work with advanced CNC machinery and precision engineering projects.  Supportive and professional team environment.  Opportunities for career development and skills advancement.  Stable employment with an established Australian manufacturing company.    Task & responsibilities   Set up and operate CNC machining equipment, including CNC milling and turning machines.  Read and interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, and production instructions.  Perform machining operations to produce precision components.  Select and change cutting tools, fixtures, and machine settings as required.  Conduct quality checks using measuring equipment such as micrometers, verniers, and gauges.  Identify and resolve machining issues to maintain production efficiency.  Perform routine machine maintenance and maintain a clean and safe work environment.  Follow workplace health and safety procedures and quality control requirements.    Qualification & experience   Relevant trade qualification in machining, engineering, or manufacturing (preferred).  Previous experience as a Metal Machinist (First Class) / CNC Machine Operator/Programmer, or similar role.  Experience operating CNC milling and/or turning machines.  Ability to interpret technical drawings and use precision measuring instruments.  Strong understanding of machining processes, tooling, and quality standards.  Ability to work independently and as part of a production team.  Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing quality work.   About Company    Zenith Vinyl Pty Ltd is an Australian manufacturer based in Brunswick East, Victoria, specialising in vinyl record production and precision-engineered tooling for the global vinyl record industry. Established in 2013, the company combines advanced CNC machining, engineering, and manufacturing expertise to design and produce high-quality molds, tooling, spare parts, and vinyl records for customers in Australia and overseas. With a strong focus on innovation, craftsmanship, and quality, Zenith Vinyl continues to support the growing global demand for premium vinyl manufacturing solutions.
